class.name: LanguageSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the language: locale, locale channels, pseudolocalization, layout direction and auto-translate mode.

method.name: get_available_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of the localization catalogs (see [method LocalizationServer.get_available_locales]) and of the loaded translations (see [method TranslationServer.get_loaded_locales]), sorted and without duplicates. Use [method TranslationServer.get_locale_name] for the names shown in a menu.

method.name: get_available_locales_for
get_command_line_locale
method.description: Returns the locale passed with the command line argument [code]--language[/code] or [code]-l[/code], or an empty string.

method.name: get_layout_direction
method.description: Returns the pending layout direction of the root window.

method.name: get_locale
method.description: Returns the pending locale chosen by the player, or an empty string if the game follows the operating system. The locale that is active now is [method TranslationServer.get_locale]; it differs while a session override is set or when no translation is loaded for the stored locale.

method.name: get_locale_for
method.description: Returns the pending locale stored for the locale [param channel] ([code]"interface"[/code], [code]"audio"[/code] or [code]"subtitles"[/code]), or an empty string if the channel is the same as the language. An empty [param channel] returns [method get_locale]. The locale that is active now is [method TranslationServer.get_locale_for].

method.name: get_project_locale
method.description: Returns the locale used for an empty [member LanguageSettings.locale]: [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/test] if it is set, otherwise the locale of the operating system ([method OS.get_locale]).

method.name: get_root_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Returns the pending auto-translate mode of the root window.

method.name: is_pseudolocalization_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if pseudolocalization is enabled in the pending settings.

method.name: set_layout_direction
method.description: Sets the layout direction of the root window (see [method Window.set_layout_direction]). [constant Window.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_INHERITED] follows [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/rendering/root_node_layout_direction].

method.name: set_locale
method.description: Sets the locale, for example [code]"fr"[/code] or [code]"pt-BR"[/code]. The locale is standardized (see [method TranslationServer.standardize_locale]), so [code]"pt-BR"[/code] is stored as [code]"pt_BR"[/code]. An empty string follows the operating system. Replaces a session override from the command line or the test locale.

method.name: set_locale_for
method.description: Sets the locale of the locale [param channel]: [code]"interface"[/code], [code]"audio"[/code] or [code]"subtitles"[/code] ([member LanguageSettings.interface_locale], [member LanguageSettings.audio_locale], [member LanguageSettings.subtitles_locale]). The locale is standardized; an empty string makes the channel the same as the language. An empty [param channel] is the same as [method set_locale]. Other channels are refused with an error. [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports the stored value, [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed] the locale in use.

method.name: set_root_auto_translate_mode
method.description: Sets the auto-translate mode of the root window ([member Node.auto_translate_mode]). With [constant Node.AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_DISABLED], nodes that inherit the mode show their texts untranslated.

signal.name: layout_direction_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member LanguageSettings.layout_direction] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it for layouts that are not under the root window.

signal.name: locale_changed
signal.deprecated: Use [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed], which reports the language (an empty [code]channel[/code]) and every locale channel with the locale in use.
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member LanguageSettings.locale] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. An empty [param locale] means the locale of the system. Use it for text that is not translated automatically, for example cached strings or a font for the language. [method TranslationServer.get_locale] returns the locale in use.

signal.name: pseudolocalization_enabled_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member LanguageSettings.pseudolocalization_enabled] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.

signal.name: root_auto_translate_mode_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member LanguageSettings.root_auto_translate_mode] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those.
